cards.title: Methodology for Fastidious Organisms
cards.claim: For fastidious organisms (e.g., Streptococcus spp., Haemophilus influenzae, Campylobacter spp.), MIC determination uses MH-F broth (CAMHB with 5% lysed horse blood and 20 mg/L beta-NAD). Incubation conditions vary by species (e.g., 35±1°C for 18±2h for Streptococcus; 41±1°C for 24±1h for Campylobacter).
conditions: Applicable to organisms listed in Table 1b.
Extended incubation (40-44h) may be required if growth is insufficient after 16-20h for certain species.
required_inputs: Preparation of MH-F broth with correct supplements
limitations: Growth phase of initial culture significantly affects final inoculum viability for fastidious organisms.
Requires at least two passages on suitable agar media when retrieved from freezer storage.
cards.downstream_use: Provides the correct experimental context for MIC data generation for fastidious pathogens, ensuring comparability with EUCAST breakpoints/ECOFFs.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
